title: Arcana Core Field: Integrations
summary: Connect Arcana Core to knowledge, mission, scan, and map surfaces without hard addon coupling.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Arcane Index, Grimoire, Lens, HoloMap, MissionCore, DataCore, NetCore, and Veilbound bridges all use Arcana Core as the shared vocabulary.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Index for searchable records, Grimoire for warning context, Lens for field inspection, and MissionCore for route objectives.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: When an optional bridge is absent, keep the base definition visible and let the consuming UI explain what extra addon would enrich it.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
